title: Serial Binary Addition
statement: For every natural number $N$, bit strings $a,b$ with $|a|,|b|\leq N$, and initial carry bit $c$, process the first $N$ aligned positions of $a$ and $b$, padding either word by zeros after it ends. At each position output the sum bit and update the carry by the usual binary addition rules. The value of the resulting output word plus $2^N$ times the final carry equals $\langle a\rangle+\langle b\rangle+c$, where $c$ on the right is interpreted as $0$ or $1$.
hypotheses_covered: a and b are bit strings with lengths at most N
